recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. Future SupplyRequest wording changes should be made in HL7/oo-incubator unless SupplyRequest is brought back into the active core build.
issue_request: FHIR-46342 was an Applied OO R6 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to replace SupplyRequest Boundaries and Relationships text with wording that points fulfillment/execution handling to Task and the Fulfillment/Execution section of the Request pattern, with follow-up QA to link BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense.
initial_application: Commit b180545c6113d568d8f46f3ad6da789de54d367c replaced the SupplyRequest Boundaries and Relationships paragraph with the approved authorization, SupplyDelivery, Task.focus, messaging/workflow, and Request-pattern Fulfillment/Execution language. Commit b7edf24c9afc7a687ccac5df6bc98c93786199e7 added the BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense link requested in Jira comments. The checked-in core source still contains that text in source/supplyrequest/supplyrequest-introduction.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-45872 is the same change family's central Request-pattern guidance issue and FHIR-51003 is a related correction to the same SupplyRequest paragraph; both are already represented on the combined branch. After FHIR-46342 was applied, commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed SupplyRequest and related OO resources from active core fhir.ini configuration and pointed core narrative links to the HL7 OO Incubator IG. Current source/fhir.ini has no active SupplyRequest entry, build.fhir.org/supplyrequest.html returns 404, and HL7/oo-incubator includes SupplyRequest as an IG resource with the same fulfillment guidance in input/pagecontent/StructureDefinition-SupplyRequest-intro.xml.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The combined-branch commit is an empty external-repo audit because editing source/supplyrequest in core would modify inactive source, while the active external OO Incubator source already contains the Jira-approved Fulfillment/Execution link text.
